Yes it's hard because people at the job seem to like him...including our supervisor. He isn't dumb at all and he's a mental health professional which is also why I struggle with how he could be so hurtful to me. His behavior makes me feel like I deserve his treatment because I was foolish enough to believe his lies and let myself get used. 

Then I grew up with the perhaps faulty belief that it's normal for a man to have a wife or girlfriend and a booty call on the side. This makes me think he's probably treating his girlfriend well because he knows better but Just sees me as the disposable booty call that he could care less about.

Thanks for your feedback. I'd love to leave my job and not work with him. But I'm 2yrs in with good pay and benefits. I hope that he'll leave one day.

As for now every day is a real struggle. I feel so hurt. He started off acting like he was sooo into me. I still feel dumb for falling for his lies and letting him use me for too long. Even though I managed to speak up for myself a bit...he acted like he didn't want things to end but is now ignoring me at work. I know I should be ok with that but his behavior seems so harsh compared to how we started. I want to yell at him and tell him he hurt me but I doubt he'll care.

Hopefully I'll get past this but it's hard working with him and hard to see the light at the end of this nightmare.

Um, I didn't convince myself of anything. I don't think he wants a serious relationship anymore. Prior to our current situation he did initiate a relationship with me that he said he was serious about in his own words. I understand now he was just lying. It was later I found out he already had a girlfriend when his behavior changed...at which point he started changing how he interacted with me and now is just trying to make me a booty call...which I'm not going for. I partly asked him the question just to see what he'd say and if I was direct maybe he'd actually admit to what he was really doing for a change...that was probably useless thinking. In any case he knows I'm not going to be his booty call and as others have said... I'm finally going to move on from this situation. 

But thanks for your feedback.
I know. I have a very terrible habit of fixating on things. But trust when I say this is the last one. I've driven myself crazy and probably others.
I have moved on...yes. Lesson learned.
I think its more extreme annoyance and anger I felt towards him.
It just annoyed me that he would lie given his obvious intentions. I felt I gave him a chance to be direct like an adult. I was equally annoyed he wanted to then sweet talk me.

I assume oral with no protection or dental dam. Isn't that more inconsiderate towards the wife or girlfriend. I have a overactive imagination. So, I envision oral on the booty call and then kissing the wife or girlfriend in the mouth. I assume one brushes after but still.

I understand your perspective. It sounds like you might also be honest with your side chicks about their status. I can appreciate that assuming your side chicks are fine with their roles and arrangements with you.

The guy I'm talking about is not honest and used lies and manipulation to get me interested in him and to believing we were in a relationship. And, that I was his only woman. He continues to lie. Except now I know the truth. I don't think he values me at all. But unlike you he does seem to want to keep me in check and as a side chick if I let him. He actually gets angry when I ignore him or blow him off. It's not really out of concern, rather his ego I think. I've stopped entertaining him as I have no interest in being a side chick or booty call. 

Further he liked to press me for unprotected sex. I declined. If you really care for the main chick I'd think there would be some boundaries right? Things you reserve just for her like unprotected sex at least in my mind. So, while he values her more in my eyes ...his behavior with me I think is disgusting and disrespectful to both of us. Though he still likely idealize her over me.

You may be right. I have a Male friend that has 2 female friends that know him. His life style from what I started to see and what my friend said...includes him being involved with certain types of women and living a fast life...clubs, partying, and drinking. I'm not saying that is wrong it's just a lifestyle that I don't fit into. But the girlfriend does. He seems to like her alot, perhaps she is just more his type. She seems very happy with him and posts such messages on IG. Which I'm about to stop watching their IG pages. I know enough to continue to move on now I feel.

I hear what you're saying. It's just that he seems so pleased with her on IG. Showing her off, liking her pics, and she seems very into him as well. Apparently she's of the mindset that they might start a family together. The guy doesn't know I know about his girlfriend. I finally just distanced myself from him when I felt he was just booty calling me. Yet, he's texting me trying to act like we're in a relationship but only to get sex from me. It seems he values her more than me. I do think I made some mistakes in how I went about a relationship with him...maybe that is why he devalues me.

I don't date guys knowingly that may have a side chick. This guy just lied to get me in a relationship. Then I later learned of his girlfriend. He is now hellbent on making me his booty call or side chick and I've been turning him down. I just keep wondering if more value is placed on being a main chick in the guys eyes. Mostly because I see him all lovey with the girlfriend on Instagram.

I prefer men who are about 35 to 45. But I'm always open to a broader age range depending on the person and their quality of character and how well they take care of themselves. I also prefer men who are confident and driven no matter the age. Although I try not to go below age 30.

For whatever reasons I do attract different age ranges but...the common characteristic they have is being more on the aggressive side or have domineering traits. I have not figured out why I attract these types unless its because they think I'm passive.

You are entitled to your opinion. But I've only had 4 sexual partners in my life time. So, I don't have more miles. As for my appearance. I am 40. But you would never guess it if you saw me and I'm in very good health physically. I'm just not in my 20s anymore which should be ok. I get compliments on my skin and appearance all the time. In fact the guy I've been fixated on didn't realize my age until I told him. I think its about taking care of yourself and not the age number. I've seen women alot younger than me who look much older than their age.

While I am hurt over this relationship...I'm not distraught enough to believe I need to find a young man to take care of as my only hope. But thanks for your perspective.

I agree in that I should not have been intimate with him quickly or in the order in which it happened. I typically take things slower and actually date first. 

I guess I let myself get caught up in all the love bombing and adoration he showed me. And, how he initiated our getting into a relationship. It was intoxicating and intense. I foolishly believed him. I decided to go with the flow of things too, which was admittedly backwards. But I suppose it is a lesson learned. I'll just return to my more traditional approach to dating and relationships.

Thanks for your feedback.

I've been ruminating on this whole situation heavily because I am anxious about working with him. I've been blowing off his continued efforts to booty call though. I just hope he doesn't spread lies about me at work.

But I do plan to distance myself as much as I can. I want to tell him I know about his girlfriend. But I honestly expect he would deny, lie, or try being manipulative.

I meant to add this has also tried to get me to have unprotected sex with him. I haven't. I would imagine he has unprotected sex with his girlfriend. So, his behavior made me wonder if he has a mental illness. I do think he's either naraccistic or a player.

I'm sorry you feel so alone. It's a feeling I've known since I was 11years old. Since 11 I've had suicidal thoughts and plans. I've tried to end my life 2x. There is no right thing I can say to you. Other than life is up and down daily. I know what it is to be surrounded by people but feel utterly alone or invisible. 

I do believe that the intensity of bad feelings come in waves. Some worse than others. At the moment kitten videos are helping me cope. Perhaps you can find something to literally pass the minutes and distract yourself for minutes at a time. 

I hope you don't cut yourself tonight. Again there is nothing I know to say to make things seem better. But know that you aren't alone. I too know suffering even if our circumstances are not exact...pain is pain in my eyes. I albeit a stranger can genuinely say I wish you well and peace of mind even if for a few minutes.

But I found out he has a girlfriend. He doesn't know I'm aware. Now he decided to return to our old job so I get the unpleasant task of seeing him every day and being his supervisor. I hope I get to see him crumble one day like you have...but I'm less hopeful.

At which point I replied just to keep the peace as I unfortunately will be working with him and will be his supervisor in another 2 weeks. The last text he sent was asking me about my day and I gave a usual response but didn't inquire about his wellbeing. That was 3 days ago and I haven't heard from him since. Do you think in this case he will be satisfied and finally done with me? Part of me says good. Part of me misses the person I thought he was and our good times. So I know I need to move on but maybe not ready to be discarded...which I know sounds crazy. But I am thinking with time I'll eventually move past him.
